script.source: if (!(ctx.source instanceof Map)) { def name = ctx.source != null ? ctx.source.toString() : 'vpc_flow'; ctx.source = ['name': name, 'type': 'network']; }
if (!(ctx.cloud instanceof Map)) { ctx.cloud = new HashMap(); } if (!(ctx.cloud.account instanceof Map)) { ctx.cloud.account = new HashMap(); }

ctx.tags = ['_ingest_failure']; if (ctx._ingest != null) { def t = ctx._ingest.on_failure_processor_type; def msg = ctx._ingest.on_failure_message; ctx.ingest_error = (t != null ? t + ': ' : '') + (msg != null ? msg : 'pipeline-vpcflow failure'); } else { ctx.ingest_error = 'pipeline-vpcflow failure'; }
